settings.text:
Explore Ancient Egypt with Kryon as Your Guide

Join Lee Carroll, Monika Muranyi, Elan Cohen, and Kryon on a rare opportunity to experience a sacred, multidimensional journey through ancient Egypt. As Kryon returns to this powerful land, you’ll travel with your Kryon soul family to some of the most awe-inspiring and energetically significant sites on the planet.

This 12-day transformational adventure invites you to move beyond time and space—into a field of allied consciousness rooted in wisdom, compassion, and love. With private access to sacred temples, time on the Nile, and live Kryon channelings, this is more than a tour—it’s a soul-level activation wrapped in the energy of galactic remembrance.

Together, we will co-create light and expand global consciousness.

"May you always drink from the Nile." – Kryon
What's Included:
Kryon channellings every day!
Tours in English-language by professional Egyptologist tour guides.

A wonderful program on 2 deluxe chartered Nile cruise boats; Lower Nile: 5-Star Mövenpick M/S. Royal Lily. Sailing on the Nile is an experience to cherish. It is like time is standing still and you feel you are back in an ancient time, sailing again to your favorite Temple.
Visits to all the great Temples along the Upper and Lower Nile, The Sphinx, the Great Pyramids, and the Giza Plateau and much more as listed in itinerary.

settings.title: The only tour in the world Lee Carroll & Monika Muranyi are going to!
Day 1 – Tuesday, February 3rd - ARRIVAL DAY
settings.text:
• Check-in at 3:00 PM
  • Overnight in Cairo – The Nile Ritz-Carlton Hotel
  • Meals on your own

settings.title: Day 2 – Wednesday, February 4th - Pyramids & Temples of Abusir and Dahsur
settings.text:
• Overnight Cairo – The Nile Ritz-Carlton Hotel
  • Breakfast & Lunch Included

We have arranged for an early morning PRIVATE VISIT to the Sun Temple of Userkaf to view the Sunrise. This was an ancient Egyptian temple dedicated to the sun god Ra built by pharaoh Userkaf, the founder of the Fifth Dynasty of Egypt.
settings.dropdown_text:
The temple lies between the Abusir pyramid field to the south and the locality of Abu Gurab. The ancient name of the temple was Nekhen-Re meaning the “Stronghold of Ra”. Lunch en route.

After breakfast en route we will visit The Red Pyramid, also called the North Pyramid, which is the largest of the three major pyramids located at the Dahshur necropolis. Named for the rusty reddish hue of its red limestone stones, it is also the third largest Egyptian pyramid, after those of Khufu and Khafra at Giza. It is also believed to be Egypt’s first successful attempt at constructing a “true” smooth-sided pyramid.

We continue with a visit to The Bent Pyramid, which is located at the royal necropolis of Dahshur, built under the Old Kingdom Pharaoh Sneferu. A unique example of early pyramid development in Egypt, this was the second pyramid built by Sneferu. The Bent Pyramid rises from the desert at a 54-degree inclination, but the top section (above 47 metres) is built at the shallower angle of 43 degrees, lending the pyramid its very obviously ‘bent’ appearance.

The Grand Egyptian Museum, also known as the Giza Museum, is a planned museum of artifacts of ancient Egypt. Described as the largest archaeological museum in the world, the museum is situated on 120 acres of land approximately two kilometers from the Giza pyramids, and is part of a new master plan for the plateau.

settings.title: Day 3 - Thursday, February 5th - Giza Plateau & The Sphinx
settings.text:
• Overnight Cairo – The Nile Ritz-Carlton Hotel
  • Breakfast & Lunch Included

Full day tour of the Giza Plateau and Sphinx Complex. See the three Pyramids and the Valley Temple.
settings.dropdown_text:
Private Visit to The Great Pyramid and time in the King’s Chamber!

Private Visit to The Great Sphinx, the most powerful vortex point on the planet. The lion in the sky is linked with the Sphinx on Earth, and they contain the knowledge of our true origin.

Lunch in the 9 Pyramids Panorama Restaurant.

settings.title: Day 4 - Friday, February 6th - Nile Cruise & Elephantine Island
settings.text:
• Flight to Aswan
  • Overnight on Royal Lily Cruise
  • Breakfast, Lunch, & Dinner included

After breakfast, check-out from The Nile Ritz-Carlton Hotel and transfer to our private charter flight from Cairo Airport to Aswan.
settings.dropdown_text:
Transfer to our chartered 5-Star Mövenpick MS Royal Lily– considered to be one of the most luxurious Nile Cruise Ships on the Lower Nile – for a 7 nights / 8 days Lower Nile Cruise, sailing from Aswan to Luxor, Qena, Luxor, then back to Aswan, on full board basis including all meals.

An amazing luxury Nile cruise that provides the ultimate in comfort, elegance and design. Movenpick MS Royal Lily features the highest quality for your enjoyment. Sailing on the Nile is an experience to cherish. It is like time is standing still and you feel you are back in an ancient time, sailing again to your favorite temple.

In the late afternoon enjoy a Felucca sail with a visit to Elephantine Island to see the Temple of Khnum. Here was the ram-headed god of the Cataracts, also known as a creator god, for it is said he fashioned man on a potter’s wheel. We will also see an excavation of a 6th century Jewish community with their Temple that was called the House of Yahweh.

settings.title: Day 5 – Saturday, February 7th - Nile Cruise & Temple Visits
settings.text:
• Overnight in Edfu on Royal Lily Cruise
  • Breakfast, Lunch, & Dinner included

We have arranged for a PRIVATE VISIT before it opens to the public to the beautiful Temple of Isis at Philae to watch the New “Dawn” and to connect with the divine goddess energies.
settings.dropdown_text:
We will visit the amazing temple and ask for a healing from Isis to awaken our full potential as we journey on the Nile.

Returning to our amazing Nile Cruise, we sail to the dual Temple of Kom Ombo. This Temple is unique as it is dedicated to two Great Gods: Horus the divine Hawk and Sobek the crocodile God, which symbolize the duality of our own higher and lower natures.

settings.title: Day 6 – Sunday, February 8th - Nile Cruise & Temple Visits
settings.text:
• Overnight in Luxor on Royal Lily Cruise
  • Breakfast, Lunch, & Dinner included

For our group we have again made arrangements to have a PRIVATE VISIT before it opens to the public. Visit to Edfu Temple – this magnificent Temple is one of the best preserved of all the temples. The inscriptions describe the mysteries of the “First Time” Zep Tepe: the age when the Gods ruled Egypt.
settings.dropdown_text:
A library of ancient esoteric knowledge was once archived here. Ancient Egypt created a harmonious cosmology that reflected a conscious spiritual reality based on direct knowingness of the natural laws of the Universe. They created sacred physical structures that mimic the harmonic golden ratio found in nature to maintain universal harmony. This Temple is energetically connected to Denderah where it also taught about the meaning of Divine Union within self. We then sail to Luxor going through the Esna Locks.

In the evening we visit Luxor Temple (also referred to as the Temple of Man) during sunset, when the temple is lit. Here sacred geometry is infused into the heart of this temple.

settings.title: Day 7 – Monday, February 9th - Nile Cruise & Valley of Kings & Queens
settings.text:
• Overnight in Luxor on Royal Lily Cruise
  • Breakfast, Lunch, & Dinner included

Visit the west bank and see the most breathtaking beautifully preserved tomb in Egypt of Queen Nefertari in the Valley of the Queens.
settings.dropdown_text:
After this, we continue to experience the exquisite Temple of the female pharaoh Hatshepsut, one of the most beautiful masterpieces of the ancient world. Return to Cruise for Lunch.

We then continue to the Valley of the Kings with its deep subterranean tombs of the ancient Kings of Egypt.

settings.title: Day 8 – Tuesday, February 10th - Nile Cruise & Temples
settings.text:
• Overnight in Qena on Royal Lily Cruise
  • Breakfast, Lunch, & Dinner included

Early morning visit to Karnak and a PRIVATE VISIT to see the Shrine of Sekhmet. We will explore Karnak Temple with its huge columns that reach to the stars.
settings.dropdown_text:
It was said that the ancient ones built these columns with special stones to collect and store the energies of their sacred singing and chanting that was done daily at dawn as the priests and priestess walked down the processional path to the Holies of Holies. Then daily the stored energy within the columns would fill the Temple spaces, energizing those who visited this sacred Temple throughout the day. We will be at the Seven Gates to Heaven door at Osiris temple.

Sail to Qena. After lunch we will visit Denderah Temple dedicated to Hathor, Goddess of love and joy. Experience the famous circular zodiac ceiling and secret crypts with enigmatic images. Denderah Temple was considered a university of higher learning and ancient Stargate and is still alive today.

settings.title: Day 9 – Wednesday, February 11th - Nile Cruise & Abydos
settings.text:
• Overnight in Luxor on Royal Lily Cruise
  • Breakfast, Lunch, & Dinner included

After breakfast, we drive by bus to visit Abydos. This amazing, beautiful Temple built by Seti I was dedicated to Osiris. It was considered a profound pilgrimage place and over the centuries pilgrims came with offering pots to ask for a blessing from the beloved god Osiris.
settings.dropdown_text:
Today it is one of the most amazing sites in Egypt. Abydos Temple was considered a university of higher learning and ancient Stargate and is still alive today.

We will have a PRIVATE VISIT to see the ancient mysterious Osireion mythological structure. Return for lunch and then sail back to Luxor.

settings.title: Day 10 – Thursday, February 12th - Sailing The Nile
settings.text:
• Overnight in Aswan on Royal Lily Cruise
  • Breakfast, Lunch, & Dinner included
settings.dropdown_text: Full day sailing on the Nile as we make our way back to Aswan, relaxing, integrating and deepening our experience of the tour. We will end the day with Galabia Party and festive Farewell Dinner for the Lower Nile cruise.

settings.title: Day 11 – Friday, February 13th - Flight to Cairo
settings.text:
• Overnight in Cairo at Le Meridien Airport Hotel
  • Breakfast & Lunch included

settings.subtitle: YOUR GUIDES
settings.title: Lee Carroll, Channeler of KRYON
settings.text: Since 1989, Lee has channelled the loving messages of Kryon to the world. He is the author of fourteen Kryon books, and co-author of:The Indigo Children, An Indigo Celebration, and The Indigo Children Ten Years Later,which have been translated into dozens of languages.These Indigo books introduced the term “Indigo Children” to the world. In recognition of Lee’s service to humanity the WATKINSMind, Body, Spiritmagazine listed Lee Carroll on numerous occasions as one of the100 most spiritually influential living people.Together with his partner, Monika Muranyi, Lee continues to deliver Kryon’s messages online as part of the popularWednesdays with Kryonweekly program and in-person events.

settings.title: Monika Muranyi
settings.text: Following a spiritual awakening Monika has become the commensurate researcher and archivist of the Kryon material. She is the author of four Kryon books that provide detailed information about subject driven topics such as Gaia, the Akash, the Soul, and Lemuria. In addition, Monika has created two beautifully illustrated oracle card decks. Together with her partner, Lee Carroll, Monika continues to assist in the delivery of Kryon’s messages online and in-person events.
